findings.description: TestFormatDoctorStatus does not lock the 'err + warnings → err wins' behavior. If a future refactor makes FormatDoctorStatus append warnings even on err, the dashboard would show 'Doctor: unavailable (X) AND N warnings', which is misleading. Easy follow-up: extend the test with warnings={1 item}, err=non-nil → expect 'unavailable' substring and absence of 'warning' substring.
findings.author: runner

findings.description: FormatDoctorStatus returns fmt.Sprintf("Doctor: %d warnings", n) for all n>0, so singular is 'Doctor: 1 warnings'. Tests use Contains("1 warning") which also matches the plural form, so the bug is masked. Fix pluralization (1 warning / N warnings) and assert exact or non-plural for n=1.
findings.author: coordinator
